verdict_scope: No current Psephos asset supports a nontrivial, independently checkable Harvey/Legora-grade legal-change or continual-maintenance reward. Transfer Eval remains a defensible normalization auxiliary, not the thesis.
episode_bundle_reason: Every candidate either lacks retained oracle bytes, exposes the target directly, reduces to parsing or joining, requires an invented authority rule, or lacks contemporaneous observations.

decision_requirements: not directly copied from the supplied input
materially harder than a parser, hash, lookup, group-by, or set difference
no LLM judge as the primary oracle
no benchmark-authored legal rule or unverifiable legal judgment

openstates_state_corpus.chapter_or_law_identifier_regex: chapter|public law|public act|law number|session law|statutes of|(^|[^a-z])act[ .:-]*[0-9]

openstates_api_to_bulk_update_probe.assessment: Exact set difference recovers recorded changes; predicting the five later votes would require predicting human events, and the four identity crosswalks are not officially adjudicated.

candidate_signals.input: Bounded OpenStates CSV rows, artifact provenance, and a cutoff.
candidate_signals.hidden_target: Normalized bill, action, roll-call, member-vote, and provenance records at the cutoff.
candidate_signals.verifier: Exact semantic projection from the private Time Machine oracle.
candidate_signals.leakage_route: The raw rows expose every substantive target fact; all state artifacts share one observation instant.
candidate_signals.naive_baseline: A schema-specific CSV parser plus date comparison.
candidate_signals.transfer_hypothesis: Evidence intake, cutoff discipline, deterministic tool use, and provenance preservation.
candidate_signals.decision: Keep Transfer Eval as plumbing; it is not legal-change or continual-maintenance supervision.

candidate_signals.input: The June 21 API slice and June 24 bulk snapshot for 73 overlapping AZ, CA, and TX bills.
candidate_signals.hidden_target: Recorded additions, deletions, identity changes, and newly available events.
candidate_signals.verifier: Exact source-ID and field set difference.
candidate_signals.leakage_route: Both snapshots directly contain the answer; withholding the later snapshot makes new human votes unpredictable.
candidate_signals.naive_baseline: Hash join and set difference obtains the full recorded delta.
candidate_signals.transfer_hypothesis: Firm-memory maintenance and source update diligence.
candidate_signals.decision: This is generic CDC/ETL, not an agentic legal-maintenance target.

candidate_signals.input: Dated actions and 3.46 million state document/version links.
candidate_signals.hidden_target: Textual change, affected provisions, and propagation into later versions.
candidate_signals.verifier: Byte-level or structured diff against retained official before/after text.
candidate_signals.leakage_route: Version names and URLs disclose labels but not content.
candidate_signals.naive_baseline: Copy version labels or order dated links; no baseline can recover absent text.
candidate_signals.transfer_hypothesis: Contract redlining, statutory change tracing, and diligence.
candidate_signals.decision: Zero retained state text pairs and zero federal multi-version chains leave no verifier.

candidate_signals.input: Became-law actions and chapter/public-law-like prose identifiers.
candidate_signals.hidden_target: Official law identity, enacted bytes, and codified sections affected.
candidate_signals.leakage_route: A regex can copy chapter numbers from action prose.
candidate_signals.naive_baseline: Regex extraction of the visible identifier.
candidate_signals.transfer_hypothesis: Legal research, updating, and current-law verification.
candidate_signals.decision: The law_links table and retained statute/public-law corpus are empty.

candidate_signals.input: OpenStates and BILLSTATUS metadata for 53,724 matching federal bills.
candidate_signals.hidden_target: A reconciled authoritative title and temporal explanation for differences.
candidate_signals.verifier: Independent official title types and publication history.
candidate_signals.leakage_route: If BILLSTATUS is supplied, its target string is directly copyable; if withheld, source preference is unstated.
candidate_signals.naive_baseline: Exact join on Congress, type, and number followed by field diff.
candidate_signals.decision: The 752 remaining differences mix legitimate title variants and cutoff differences, with no adjudicated semantic gold.

candidate_signals.input: CourtListener metadata, 500-character snippets, listed cited IDs, and the citation-alias table.
candidate_signals.hidden_target: Substantive opinion revisions, supported cited-authority table, and currentness/treatment.
candidate_signals.verifier: Before/after official opinion bytes plus authority and treatment graph.
candidate_signals.leakage_route: Cited IDs are listed directly; retained snippets omit the document body.
candidate_signals.naive_baseline: ID lookup for covered aliases or timestamp sort for named revisions.
candidate_signals.transfer_hypothesis: Citation grounding, source review, and ongoing authority maintenance.
candidate_signals.decision: No PDFs/full text or treatment graph is retained; lookup coverage is incomplete and some aliases are ambiguous.

candidate_signals.input: Retained immutable files and their source manifests.
candidate_signals.hidden_target: Correct URL, hash, size, observation time, and record-to-artifact anchor.
candidate_signals.leakage_route: URLs, times, and expected hashes are manifest fields.
candidate_signals.naive_baseline: Hash bytes and copy manifest values.
candidate_signals.decision: A valuable invariant and reward component, but not a standalone legal-agent signal.

candidate_signals.hidden_target: LOCUS function, topic, substantive flag, and dimension scores.
candidate_signals.verifier: Dataset-provided labels rather than independent legal truth.
candidate_signals.leakage_route: Labels are stored beside each record; most text is a short heading.
candidate_signals.decision: Static derived labels, no temporal law, generic provenance, and a non-commercial license do not meet the bar.

minimum_missing_evidence_for_reconsidera: content-addressed official before/after legal text with publication observations
official public-law/chapter and historical code or statute bytes
adjudicated source authority and title/type semantics
full opinion revisions plus citation treatment/currentness data
multiple contemporaneous observations of the same legal matter
